definitions.gloss: preparation; arrangement; plan; schedule of steps
definitions.explanation: The organized sequence of steps or preparations needed to accomplish something smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{段取|だんど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's decide on the arrangements for the meeting.

examples.japanese: {段取|だんど}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took a long time because the planning was poor.

examples.japanese: {段取|だんど}り⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please proceed according to the plan.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Originally a theater term referring to the steps (⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧) of a plot or the arrangement of scenes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {段取|だんど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ / ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make arrangements/plans)
- {段取|だんど}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad planning)
- {段取|だんど}り⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (according to plan)
- {段取|だんど}り{八分|はちぶ} (good preparation is 80% of success)

USAGE:
{段取|だんど}り emphasizes the practical sequence of steps rather than abstract planning. It's commonly used in work contexts where efficiency matters.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ (preparation) - general preparation
- ⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧ (procedure) - specific sequence of steps
- {段取|だんど}り - focuses on organizing workflow efficiently
